summary: Enforce wellmanifest git-lifecycle 6 hard vetos in project_scanner

delivery.outcome: Enforce all 6 canonical wellmanifest/git-lifecycle hard vetos in fixos/diagnostics/project_scanner.py so protected repos and worktrees resolve to HOLD_PROTECTED and never emit unsafe deletion candidates.
nonGoals: Modifying fixos/cli/fix_cmd.py or any file reserved by active foreign leases.

architecture.decision: Add CleanupVetoReport and evaluate_cleanup_vetos covering active processes, active leases, open PRs/unmerged commits, dirty/stash state, unpushed refs, and linked worktree/primary/IDE ownership in fixos/diagnostics/project_scanner.py, enforced by default in scan_project_artifacts.
interfaceChanges: Add CleanupVetoReport, evaluate_cleanup_vetos, and optional enforce_vetos/include_protected/open_pr_checker parameters to scan_project_artifacts
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit touching fixos/diagnostics/project_scanner.py and tests/unit/test_project_scanner.py.

validation.evidence: All 6 canonical hard vetos force HOLD_PROTECTED and suppress unsafe deletion proposals in unit tests while keeping existing scanner tests passing.
